src/building/search/building-search.repo: the building search returns one `$facet` whose ranked rows and campus counts come from a single predicate (docs/decisions/0006-building-search-relevance-ranking.md), so dropping a row after the pipeline would make `counts` and `total` disagree with it; under ADR 0010 D2 the rows are typed as the stored `BuildingDoc` the list and detail reads parse

an aggregate projects inside its pipeline, not in the options argument this rule reads: `BUILDING_SEARCH.projection` in building-search.query.ts is the `$project` stage of each ranked band of `rankedSearchPipeline` (ADR 0010 D2)

space search rows come out of the same single-predicate `$facet` as their campus counts (ADR 0006), so a row dropped by a parse would leave `counts` and `total` counting it; ADR 0010 D2 types these rows as `SpaceDoc`, whose other reads in catalog and place parse through `storedSpace`

the `$project` that trims a matched space lives in the pipeline (`SPACE_SEARCH.projection`, building-search.query.ts), where an aggregate projects, rather than in the driver options this check inspects (ADR 0010 D2)
src/notices/detail/notices-detail.reposi: ADR 0010 D2 types the hot, uncached notice reads instead of parsing them per request; the detail read projects `DETAIL_PROJECTION` and returns the typed document, and the crawler's generated type replaces this hand-written one (spencer0124/skkuverse#68)
src/notices/list/notices-list.repository: the member lookup runs inside the same uncached list request as `listNotices`, up to once per scanned batch, so under ADR 0010 D2 it projects `CLUSTER_MEMBER_PROJECTION` and types the four fields it reads as `ClusterMember`, as the list read types its rows, until the crawler's exported document type replaces the hand-written one (spencer0124/skkuverse#68)

every list page is a hot read with no cache in front (ADR 0010 D2), so `listNotices` projects `LIST_PROJECTION` and trusts the corrected `NoticeDoc` type rather than running zod over up to 51 documents per request
src/notices/overview/notices-overview.re: the `$rankFusion` pipeline in notices-overview.query.ts returns a `$project` of the candidate fields, typed as `OverviewCandidate` under ADR 0010 D2; parsing it waits for the crawler's exported document schema (spencer0124/skkuverse#68)

an aggregate projects inside its pipeline, not in the options argument this rule reads: `CANDIDATE_PROJECTION` is the `$project` stage of `toOverviewPipeline` in notices-overview.query.ts (ADR 0010 D2)
